sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops analytics and crash reporting, which receive your reservation and payment details.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Stops the "rate this app" prompt after checkout.
Shows ticket lottery, ticket sales, and booking details the app receives but hides.
Stops the app from reading your precise location every time you open it.
Hides your mobile carrier from the app, or reports a carrier name you choose.
